storeCopy.seoTitle: TikTok Trending Feed Scraper | Popular Videos
storeCopy.seoDescription: Get TikTok trending videos with creators, captions, plays, likes, shares, and sound details. Choose a region to capture its public feed for research.
storeCopy.intro: Capture TikTok’s public trending feed for a selected market with video captions, creator profiles, engagement totals, and sound information. Each row represents a trending post.
useCases: Social analysts can review public videos gaining reach in a selected market.
Content teams can compare trending captions, sounds, and engagement.
Researchers can save regional TikTok feed snapshots for later analysis.
howToUse: Add a TikTok region code such as `GB` to `regions`.
Optionally set `count` to request up to 20 feed items.
Use `maxResults` to limit the number of video rows saved.

faqs.question: Why does the US feed sometimes fail?
faqs.answer: Feed availability can vary by market and source response. Choose another supported region if a market is temporarily unavailable.

fields.name: aweme_id
fields.description: TikTok identifier for the video post.

fields.name: video_id
fields.description: Alternate video identifier returned with the post.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Market code associated with the feed result.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Short description or caption attached to the video.

fields.name: content_desc
fields.description: Content phrases associated with the post.

fields.name: cover
fields.description: URL of the default video cover image.

fields.name: ai_dynamic_cover
fields.description: URL of the animated or dynamic cover when supplied.

fields.name: origin_cover
fields.description: URL of the original cover image.

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Video length in seconds.

fields.name: play
fields.description: Playback reference returned for the video.

fields.name: wmplay

fields.name: size
fields.description: Reported size of the video media asset in bytes.

fields.name: wm_size
fields.description: Reported size of the watermarked media asset in bytes.

fields.name: music
fields.description: Music identifier or reference attached to the post.

fields.name: play_count
fields.description: Number of plays reported for the video.

fields.name: digg_count
fields.description: Number of likes reported for the video.

fields.name: comment_count
fields.description: Number of comments reported for the video.

fields.name: share_count
fields.description: Number of shares reported for the video.

fields.name: download_count
fields.description: Number of downloads reported for the video.

fields.name: collect_count
fields.description: Number of saves reported for the video.

fields.name: create_time

fields.name: anchors
fields.description: Commercial anchor data, or null when none is supplied.

fields.name: anchors_extras
fields.description: Serialized metadata for commercial anchors.

fields.name: is_ad
fields.description: True when TikTok marks the post as an advertisement.

fields.name: commerce_info

fields.description: Commercial status information for the post.

fields.name: item_comment_settings
fields.description: Numeric comment-setting code returned for the video.

fields.name: mentioned_users

fields.description: Public TikTok profile details for the video author.

fields.name: author_avatar

fields.name: music_title
fields.description: Sound title associated with the TikTok video.

fields.name: music_author
